nodes.label: L1 records dir: run records and step folders live in .sdlc/runtime/tasks/<key>/ (helper, writers, order.py, hooks, run.sh)
nodes.accept: `bash plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/check.sh` exits 0, and the dispatch.py selftest shows a prepare+record cycle leaving `git status --porcelain -- <task dir>` empty apart from handoff.md, while a legacy task dir holding runs.jsonl keeps writing in place (negative control)

nodes.label: L2 cost, board and fleet readers find records through the helper
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/report.py selftest`, `solo_stats.py`, `board.py selftest`, `fleet_collect.py selftest` and `fleet_status.py selftest` exit 0 with a runtime-only fixture reporting nonzero cost under the right ticket key; the same fixture with the runtime dir removed falls back to the legacy folder (negative control)

nodes.label: L3 fanout carries records by copy, not commit
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/fanout.py selftest` exits 0 with a land whose close commit tracks only handoff.md under the ticket folder, and a branch with no worktree still lands from git objects (negative control: deleting the copy step makes the land report no verifier result)

nodes.label: L4 close writes the Outcome; filer opt-in; side files stop
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/tickets.py selftest` and `redck.py selftest` exit 0 with: close with a passing verifier result appends ## Outcome with lane, verdict, Check and Commits lines; close with a failing newest verifier refuses (negative control); no process-deviations.md or refusals.jsonl is written

nodes.label: L5 top-level layout rule, skill write locations, tidy migration
nodes.accept: `python3 plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/tickets.py selftest` exits 0 with: check warns on a stray top-level file and not on an allowed name (negative control); tidy without --apply changes nothing; tidy --apply moves the stray file into archive/ and refuses while a .running marker exists

nodes.label: L6 docs, release notes from commit subjects, version 0.23.0
nodes.accept: `bash plugins/sdlc-lite/scripts/check.sh`, `python3 scripts/check-packaging.py` and `git diff --check` pass; levels.json and models.json are unchanged since the wave base; a live solo L2 ticket in a throwaway project leaves `git ls-files .sdlc/.NNNN-*` equal to handoff.md

nodes.label: Design record: inventory with fates, per-reader replacements, queue verdicts
nodes.accept: `grep -c 'T-05' .sdlc/0539-lean-work-records/architect-L1.md` is at least 8 and every inventory row names a fate (keep, runtime or stop)

actions.label: Close a ticket so git keeps only its handoff with an Outcome: changes, checks, verdict
Learn from a closed ticket alone what changed, what was checked, and the verdict
Record a process deviation as one Outcome line instead of a side file
Hand off a clean, merge-ready worktree with no ceremony files to commit
Keep run bookkeeping (attempts, dispatches, run log, skips) local and out of git
Keep the recorded build base available to builders and verifiers for the whole run
See a ticket's cost after it closes, from local run records
Decide a task's next step from its current run state
Resume or recover an interrupted role run after a host restart
Have one independent verifier per ticket judge the work with the evidence it needs
Refuse a close while follow-ups, skip records, or red checkpoints show unfinished work
Close a ticket without breaking files that reference its folder
Collect run records from several repos into one fleet view
Return fleet-retro interview answers by message, not as a file
Keep roles and skills from writing loose files at the top of .sdlc or the project root
Get a PR body or changelog draft only when someone asks for one
Write release notes from commit subjects
Keep dated docs/reports files for releases and retros only, none per ticket
Keep one authoritative location for each fact across committed and local records
Know, for every file the plugin writes, its writer, its reader, and its fate
Decide keep, merge, or drop, with one reason, for each queued ticket
Leave a consumer repo's existing closed ticket folders as they are
Preview moving a consumer repo's loose top-level .sdlc files to allowed places
Apply that one-time move only after the dry run, run by the consumer repo's owner
Keep every role's model and effort unchanged
Ship the change as SDLC Lite 0.23.0, built in waves of 3 to 6 tickets
